title: [F1-S6] Factory end-to-end dry run + runbook + metrics baseline
body:
## Plan link
https://github.com/syamaner/roastpilot-plan/blob/main/roastpilot-cloud/factory.md — §3, §10 (metrics + ratchet), §11

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] End-to-end dry run on a sacrificial issue: filed via the story template → triaged → human dispatch → PR opens → CI + review run → PM adjudicates → merged (trivial change) or closed with reasoning
- [ ] `docs/factory-runbook.md`: stuck states and recovery (triage failed, half-published branch, budget cap hit, malformed verdict), where each log lives, cost log location + format
- [ ] §10 metrics baseline recorded (triage accuracy, first-pass-green, human-touch minutes for the dry run) as the ratchet's starting point
- [ ] Any spec-vs-reality gap found in the dry run fed back to factory.md in the plan repo (same-session rule)

## In-scope surface
`docs/factory-runbook.md`, one sacrificial issue + PR, plan-repo amendment if needed.

## Out of scope
Enabling triage→implement chaining (ratchet step 1 needs ~5 clean stories, not one dry run).

## Verification notes
The dry run IS the verification; the runbook is reviewed against what actually happened, not what was expected to happen.

## Size declaration
Thin slice (≤ ~400 lines expected)
